text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While in the cafeteria, I overheard Meisho Doto
asking Manhattan Cafe and Yukino Bijin for advice.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, well, you see...
About th-this photo...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Allow me to have a look.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, this building feels a whole lot like my family's home back home.
It's real calmin'...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I heard it was a magnificent old traditional house built decades ago,
so I took a commemorative photo, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...A girl with a bob cut, wearing a kimono...
It's faintly reflected here.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Th-Th-That's righttt!!
Nobody was supposed to be there, and yet~!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This little one... is looking right at me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: That's sooo right~~~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Am I going to be cursed for taking a photo like this~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still, she's smilin', so she'll be just fine.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
She's surely a good girl who'd never do no wrong,
so please don't you worry none.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh...? I-Is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Lots of things happened back home,
but I was taught that as long as you're well-behaved,
nothing bad will ever happen!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Sure, I've heard footsteps from empty rooms
and seen pale blue lights flying around,
but look at me—fit as a fiddle!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeeek!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"If you behave like a good girl, you say...?
Fufu... That's so like you, Yukino-san."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Beings from the beyond are drawn to warm souls...
So surely... see, they're by your side again, Doto-san...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Awawa, awawawawawawa!!
Is there... Is there no salvation for us~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My eyes met Meisho Doto's,
who was trembling timidly.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Auuugh... I'm sorry for making such a fuss~.
choice_data_list: It's amazing that neither of you is afraid of ghosts...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-You're so right~...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Now, now, everything's just fine~.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
As long as we don't do anything weird to them,
they won't do a thing to us. Just like honeybees!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Besides... in terms of inspiring fear,
are not living humans and Umamusume
just the same...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeeek!! If you say that, the only thing that won't be scary anymore is the raccoon dog~~!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-san isn't scared of me, so...
she's easy to talk to.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aww, hearing you say that makes me so happy!
I could talk about it forever!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: What other kinds of mysterious experiences have you had...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
When I was playing in the mountains, I once heard
a kid's laughter right next to me even though nobody was there.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Also, in the middle of a heavy snowstorm, I once saw a woman
wearing a braided straw hat standing completely still—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeeek!!
That's not something you talk about like it's casual small talk~!
